$comment: Copy this file to vmconfig.json (do not commit it: it names a real machine) and fill it in.
The keys the runner needs: transport, host, username, interactiveUser, workDirectory, installer.
The password of the WinRM account comes from the environment variable named in passwordEnvironmentVariable.
With the transport 'ssh' the account needs a key (BatchMode=yes: no interactive password).

composition.$comment: The keys of the product: Ctrl+Alt+Space enters the composition, Enter commits it (docs/TSF_VM_TEST_PLAN.md, section 8).
